answer.summary: E2E failed because the openaev-app container crashed on startup with a duplicate Flyway migration version, V6_20261118120000000. This PR adds V6_20261118120000000__Catalog_connector_injector_contracts.java, which appears to reuse the version of an existing migration (Request_finding_refeed_for_asset_groups_side). The failure is deterministic and will repeat on re-run until the version is renamed.

evidence.quote: Caused by: java.lang.IllegalStateException: Duplicate Flyway migration version found: V6_20261118120000000__Request_finding_refeed_for_asset_groups_side.class
